data.message: All 24 others: opt in individually to 18 tons; I commit to 18 even if others choose 10. Each switch from 10 adds $8,000 now if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k, remaining=250-8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). Even all 18 leaves 50, above collapse threshold, but risks lower future stock; long-run gains aren't guaranteed. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches require recalculation.
